name: agent-verification-kit
description: Test automation and verification for agentic coding. Ships hooks, not only skills — a skill can be argued with, a hook cannot.

plugins.name: agent-verification-kit
plugins.description: Evidence-required completion, enforced where the agent cannot argue with it. A commit is blocked unless a fresh verification stamp exists; the stamp is written only by a passing test or build command, is scoped to the repository being committed to, expires after 30 minutes, and is cleared by any file edit. Also validates that every agent definition in a commit names a model that actually resolves, because a typo'd model: does not fail at runtime — it 404s, retries, and silently falls back to the dispatching session's model.
